shortDescription: A magnitude 5.6 earthquake struck near Khuzdar in Pakistan's Balochistan province on Saturday, the German Research Center for Geosciences (GFZ) said.The quake was at a depth of 10 km (6 miles), GFZ said.

children: A magnitude 5.6 earthquake struck near Khuzdar in Pakistan's Balochistan province on Saturday, the German Research Center for Geosciences (GFZ) said.
The quake was at a depth of 10 km (6 miles), GFZ said.
